capabilities: Sync personal clipped notes from Getbiji to the vault
Sync Getbiji knowledge-base topics the user created or joined
Run full or incremental syncs with date-range filters
Generate a sync report file after each sync
extras: Documentation is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Made for the Getbiji community to let fragmented reading accumulate in an Obsidian vault.
problem: Notes clipped with the Getbiji mobile app, web version, and browser extensions stay in that service and are not available locally in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: uses the official Getbiji API to seamlessly and efficiently sync the notes you've clipped

requires.name: Getbiji Client ID and API Key

summary: Sync plugin that pulls notes clipped in the Getbiji app (biji.com) into an Obsidian vault via its official API.
